releaseNotes: Go to Cell no longer resizes or restores a maximized Excel window - navigation keeps the window exactly as it was.
Workbook Audit offers additional previewed repair actions for supported formula, date, number-format, merge and duplicate-row findings - every repair is verified and can be undone.
Formula repair previews now state the exact result the repaired formula will produce before you confirm.
When Go to Cell temporarily shows a hidden worksheet to reach a finding, the status line now records which sheet was shown so it can be hidden again.
Numbers stored as text that look like identifiers (leading zeros or very long digit strings) are protected from automatic conversion - the action explains why.
External workbook findings now give clearer guidance for keeping, relinking or reviewing linked sources.
Volatile formula findings (NOW, RAND, TODAY and similar) can now be opened directly from the findings list.
